paragraphs: He is mentioned in Gittin 45b, raising an objection to Rav Ashi (as a colleague).[^1]

notes.text: The saved Davidson Gittin45b scalar explicitly has Rav Budya addressing Rav Ashi with a challenge. As a colleague is Hyman’s parenthetical characterization, not a separate historical status established by the scalar.
